text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved great results in the race, 
Hokko Tarumae, the local idol, begins to 
draw the audience's attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey sensed powerful qi from her 
running. Having just debuted herself, she 
was determined to give her all in dirt 
races to spread the word of feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, checking online revealed 
that Hokko Tarumae's personal recognition 
had increased. However, views on 
Tomakomai's promotional info hadn't grown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She announces her desire to take on a 
major challenge while the spotlight is on 
her, aiming to skyrocket her popularity by 
winning a GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae expressed her desire to 
enter the "Champions Cup," and her Trainer 
agreed.
